latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Script Generator Intl skill.
- Generate multilingual video scripts from your topic or brief, supporting TXT, DOCX, PDF, and MP4 files up to 200MB.
- Automated setup with cloud backend; supports session management and anonymous token authentication.
- Fast processing (20–40 seconds) on cloud GPUs; export results as 1080p MP4 and several other formats.
- Simple commands for upload, export, credit checking, and state tracking.
- Optimized error handling and workflow for marketers and international audiences.
